evidence.exception: Real owner resolve_approval and stored resolver callback enter real replay, selected planner/create branches and Graph serializer with isolated directory, DB, registry admission, clock and provider transport. Source A1 verified via archived hashes. Original unchanged incident included among preservation controls and historical failing pre-a1 runs are retained separately. No live replay; original Graph success checked event existence/start; per-inbox delivery and later editor identity remain unverified. Direct legacy fixture contexts carry the declared unframed literal as currentUserMessage. Orchestrated turns receive an explicit empty typedUserMessage if no typed source is available. Core, actual connector and resolver boundaries have distinct executed fixtures. Matching pre-fix original and rejected a1 are retained; external human delivery and later editor identity remain outside these checks.
